source_note: 函数与序列的上下极限
english_source_note: Limsup and Liminf of Functions and Sequences
callout_id: 函数与序列的上下极限#17
english_title: Proposition 3.5: Relation Between Existence of a Function Limit and Limit Superior/Inferior
statement_en:
Let $U:=\limsup_{x\to +\infty}f(x)$ and $L:=\liminf_{x\to +\infty}f(x)$. Then:
1. If the limit $\lim_{x\to +\infty}f(x)$ exists in $\overline{\mathbb{R}}$ and equals $\ell$, then $$U=L=\ell.$$
2. Conversely, if $U=L=\ell$, then the limit $\lim_{x\to +\infty}f(x)$ exists in $\overline{\mathbb{R}}$ and equals $\ell$.
key_techniques: characterize existence of a limit by equality of limsup and liminf
prerequisites: limit of a function at infinity
limit superior and limit inferior of functions
callout_body:
令$U:=\limsup_{x\to +\infty}f(x)$以及$L:=\liminf_{x\to +\infty}f(x)$那么：
1. 如果函数的极限$\lim_{x\to +\infty}f(x)$在$\overline{\mathbb{R}}$中存在且等于$\ell$那么$$U=L=\ell$$
2. 反过来，如果$U=L=\ell$那么函数的极限$\lim_{x\to +\infty}f(x)$在$\overline{\mathbb{R}}$中存在且等于$\ell$。
